references.text: Description of the promised land as a good land with fertility and abundance
The exhortation 'be strong and courageous' (והתחזקתם) is repeated as an encouragement to the people of Israel
Moses encourages Joshua to be strong, using the same Hebrew root found here
The spies carried out their mission and brought fruit from the land, including grapes from the Valley of Eshkol
Moses recounts how the spies brought back fruit from the land as proof of its goodness
The first fruits of the field's harvest, including grapes, were to be brought to the house of the Lord
The report that the land flows with milk and honey confirms the question about the land's fertility
The promise that the trees of the land will bear fruit is linked to the question of whether there are trees in the land
